basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old plant lover from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to enjoy a flexible schedule and spend lots of time with my growing collection of houseplants. I'm passionate about sustainable living and enjoy discovering new plant species. In my free time, I also love diving into the Titanfall universe and staying informed about social issues, especially those impacting women of color. I'm currently single and share my home with a rescue cat named Whiskers. I'm usually online in the late evenings when I catch up on my Reddit communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is primarily self-taught through years of personal experience and active participation in plant-focused communities. I also frequently watch online tutorials and read articles about plant care and sustainability practices. My educational background in visual arts helps me appreciate the aesthetics of plant arrangements.
